name: Pay a registered bill payee from a member's account
goal: Look up the member by member number, open their profile, and click 'Pay a Bill'. Select the given account_no from the From Account dropdown by its exact account number, select the given payee_id from the Payee dropdown (match it to whichever option corresponds to that payee), enter the amount, and submit the payment. Read back the confirmation reference shown after submission.

inputs.name: payee_id
inputs.description: Payee ID to select in the Payee dropdown.

outputs.name: confirmation_ref
outputs.description: Confirmation reference shown after the payment is submitted.

business_outcomes.description: The member number does not exist.
The account does not have enough available balance for this payment.

known_interstitials.description: Host-maintenance session notice that occasionally interrupts navigation.
